[[Enadiz's Defender]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[shield]] dropped by [[Enadiz the Hardheaded]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Arkjok Ward]].

==Stats==
:[[Armor rating|Armor]]: 16 (Requires 9 [[Strength]])
:Reduces [[Crippled]] duration on you by 20% (Stacking)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Shield of the Lion]] [[dye|dye]]d silver.

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*[[Shield of the Lion]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Shield Handle]] [[of Fortitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Swift as the Wind]]" inscription
*Silver [[Dye]]
